title: Interactive Ring Designer with Gems
prompt:
Create a fully interactive 3D ring designer using Three.js. Load the model 'facecap.glb' using GLTFLoader as a decorative gem holder/base element positioned at the center of the scene.

SCENE SETUP:
- Use a PerspectiveCamera at position (0, 2, 5) looking at origin.
- Add an AmbientLight (intensity 0.4) and a DirectionalLight at (5, 10, 5) with intensity 0.8.
- Add an EnvironmentMap or simple gradient background (dark to lighter gray).
- Create a torus geometry (outer radius 1.0, tube radius 0.15, radialSegments 32, tubularSegments 64) as the ring band, positioned at origin, rotated so it sits upright (rotate PI/2 on X).
- The ring band starts with gold material (MeshStandardMaterial, color #FFD700, metalness 0.9, roughness 0.1).
- Place the loaded facecap.glb model scaled to 0.3 and positioned at (0, 1.0, 0) on top of the ring as a decorative crown/setting.
- Create 6 gem slots arranged in a semicircle on the top of the ring band. Each gem is a small OctahedronGeometry(0.08, 0) with emissive material. Gems are positioned at angles [−50°, −30°, −10°, 10°, 30°, 50°] around the top of the torus at radius 1.0.
- Initially all 6 gem slots are empty (gems hidden, visible=false).

MATERIALS & GEM TYPES:
- Support 4 gem types: 'diamond' (#FFFFFF, emissive #AAAAFF), 'ruby' (#FF0033, emissive #FF0000), 'emerald' (#00CC44, emissive #00FF44), 'sapphire' (#0033FF, emissive #0000FF).
- Support 3 band materials: 'gold' (#FFD700), 'silver' (#C0C0C0), 'rose_gold' (#B76E79).

UI ELEMENTS (DOM overlay):
- A top bar with title 'Ring Designer' in elegant font.
- A 'Band Material' dropdown (id='bandMaterialSelect') with options: gold, silver, rose_gold.
- A 'Gem Type' dropdown (id='gemTypeSelect') with options: diamond, ruby, emerald, sapphire.
- A 'Selected Gem Slot' label showing current slot index (1-6).
- Buttons: 'Place Gem' (id='placeGemBtn'), 'Remove Gem' (id='removeGemBtn'), 'Clear All' (id='clearAllBtn').
- A 'Rotate Ring' checkbox (id='rotateToggle') that toggles auto-rotation.
- A 'Ring Size' slider (id='ringSizeSlider', min=0.5, max=2.0, step=0.1, default=1.0) that scales the entire ring group.
- A price display (id='priceDisplay') showing total price. Band prices: gold=500, silver=200, rose_gold=350. Gem prices: diamond=1000, ruby=750, emerald=600, sapphire=800.
- An 'Export Config' button (id='exportBtn') that logs the current configuration to console and sets a flag.

INTERACTIONS:
- Click on the ring (raycasting) to cycle through gem slot selection (0-5). Highlight selected slot with a pulsing wireframe sphere.
- Left/Right arrow keys cycle through gem slots.
- Up/Down arrow keys cycle through gem types in the dropdown.
- 'Place Gem' button places the currently selected gem type into the selected slot (makes gem visible, sets its color).
- 'Remove Gem' button hides the gem at the selected slot.
- 'Clear All' removes all gems.
- Changing band material updates the ring torus material color.
- Ring size slider scales the ring group uniformly.
- OrbitControls for camera.

STATE MANAGEMENT:
Expose window.__3D_STATE__ with:
- bandMaterial: string ('gold'|'silver'|'rose_gold')
- gemType: string (currently selected gem type)
- selectedSlot: number (0-5)
- gems: array of 6 objects [{type: string|null, visible: boolean}, ...]
- gemCount: number (count of placed gems)
- ringScale: number (current scale factor)
- totalPrice: number (computed price)
- isRotating: boolean
- rotationAngle: number (cumulative Y rotation in radians)
- modelLoaded: boolean (true when facecap.glb loaded)
- exported: boolean (true after export button clicked)
- bandColor: string (hex color of current band)

ANIMATION:
- When auto-rotate is on, rotate the ring group around Y axis at 0.01 rad/frame.
- Update rotationAngle continuously.
- Pulse the selection indicator (scale oscillation using sin(time)).

Ensure all state values update in real-time during the animation loop.
physics_constraints: Ring scale must remain within [0.5, 2.0]. Gem positions must stay on the torus surface. Price calculation must be deterministic and exact. Rotation angle must be NaN-free and monotonically increasing when rotating.
